The '''Dungeon Hub''' is a [[Locations|Location]] accessible through the [[Hub Island]] via a portal at {{Coordinates|1=-34|2=72|3=23}} or by using the [[Fast Travel]] feature in the SkyBlock Menu. This area has been made as a means to access all existing Dungeons and all Dungeon-related shops in one place.

[[File:Portal to Dungeons Hub.png|thumb|293x293px|Portal to Dungeon Hub in the [[Village]].]]

Damage (noticeably, {{DamageType|fall}}) is disabled in the Dungeon Hub.

'''NOTE:''' The Fast Travel warp is not unlocked if the player has not gone through the Portal.

{{ZoneText|Join Dungeons!|Meet new friends and organize Dungeon parties!|Talk with &cOphelia &fand &cMalik&f.}}

These are the additional tasks:
* Play with Friends!
* Create your own custom party.
* Find [[Fairy Souls#Dungeon Hub|Fairy Souls]] (7)
* Hub Racing (for [[Wither Essence]] and Speed Accessories. Located under the main dungeon area)

== Purpose ==
{{Main|Catacombs|Kuudra}}

The main purpose of the '''Dungeon Hub''' is to queue into the [[Catacombs]] and [[Kuudra]].
{{NPCSprite|Mort}} allows the player to queue into Dungeons through Party Finder; {{NPCSprite|Malik}} allows the player to upgrade items with [[Essence]], dungeonize gear, apply [[Reforging|Reforges]], and salvage items; and {{NPCSprite|Ophelia}} serves as a shop for lots of convenient Dungeon items and powerful gear, like the {{Item|Wither Goggles}}, {{Item|Giant Cleaver}}, {{Item|Death Bow}}, {{Item|Steel Chestplate}}, and {{Item|Mender Crown}}.

{{NPCSprite|Crag}} allows the player to access [[Kuudra]], and {{NPCSprite|Vulcan}} provides a shop for {{Item|Crimson Essence}}. {{NPCSprite|Vesuvius}} can also be found in the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}, who serves a similar purpose to Croseus.

{{NPCSprite|Croesus}} also allows the player to open unclaimed [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s and [[Kuudra#Loot|Kuudra Chests]] for {{Green|72}} hours, and completing [[The Catacombs - Floor III]] allows the player to access the Catacombs without a party by giving {{Item|Saul's Recommendation}} to Mort.

== Hub Racing ==
{{Main|Dungeon Hub Race}}

Players can do the Hub Racing quest by talking with {{NPCSprite|Guildford}} and selecting which destination and type of race.

There are 3 different race routes:
* Crystal Core
* Giant Mushroom
* Precursor Ruins

Each route has 4 types of race:
* Anything (can use Abilities (like {{Item|Aspect of the End}}/{{Item|Aspect of the Void|text=Void}}, {{Item|Leaping Sword|text=Leaping}}/{{Item|Silk-Edge Sword}}), {{Item|Ender Pearl}}s, and {{Item|Grappling Hook}})
* No Pearls (can use Abilities as stated above, but no Ender Pearls}}
* No Abilities (can use only the Grappling Hook)
* Nothing at all (can't use anything, and walking speed is capped at 130)

The player can choose whether or not they want to race with runback, where they must reach the goal and then run back to the start. With no runback they will be teleported back to Guildford after reaching the goal. 
In total, there are 24 different Dungeon Hub races.

For every race the player completes in time, Guildford will give 3/4/5/6 [[Wither Essence]] or a {{Item|Cat Talisman}} Upgrade.

Players can obtain the Speed Accessories by completing (4/4) objectives in at least 1 category in a location. For the rewards, the order of the races doesn't matter. 

For example, completing 4/4 objectives on Precursor Ruins + Anything + Runback would reward a {{Item|Cat Talisman}}, then completing 4/4 objectives on Precursor Ruins + Nothing at all + No Runback afterwards would reward a {{Item|Lynx Talisman}}. 

Each reward upgrades the previous:
# {{Item|Cat Talisman}} - +1 {{stat|spd}} {{Uncommon}} Accessory
# {{Item|Lynx Talisman}} - +2 {{stat|spd}} {{Rare}} Accessory
# {{Item|Cheetah Talisman}} - +3 {{stat|spd}} {{Epic}} Accessory
